**Who is this for?**
Which person does it help? (e.g., "a farmer checking market prices in
Marathi", "a student practicing English in Bhojpuri")

**What should Vaani do?**
Describe the outcome, not the implementation.

**Does it work offline, on a cheap phone, by voice, in the user's language?**
These four are non-negotiable for core features:
[Privacy Charter](../../blob/main/PRIVACY_CHARTER.md) ·
[Tender UX Principles](../../blob/main/TENDER_UX_PRINCIPLES.md)

**Is it inside the top-20 use cases?**
Check [docs/use-cases.md](../../blob/main/docs/use-cases.md). If not, tell
us why it belongs in v1 — scope discipline is how this project ships.
